**Please use GitHub Discussions for usage questions, once enabled**

Most questions filed against this tracker historically have been "how do I..."
usage questions rather than bugs or feature requests. If
[GitHub Discussions](../../discussions) is enabled for this repository, please
ask there instead — it is a better fit for Q&A (searchable, threaded answers,
doesn't compete with bug/feature triage) and keeps the issue tracker focused
on actionable bugs and feature requests.

If Discussions is not yet enabled, or your question turns out to reveal a bug
or documentation gap, feel free to continue with the form below.

**What are you trying to do?**
A description of your goal (e.g. "run 3-D elastic FWI with a free surface",
"use a custom source wavelet", "understand what the PML boundary does").

**What have you tried?**
Relevant code, and what happened when you ran it.

**Relevant documentation you've already checked**
Link any docs pages / examples you've already looked at, so we know where the
gap is if this turns into a docs fix.
